description: Step 1 (free) of the verified-operator badge. Returns one line to publish EITHER as the content of https://<domain>/.well-known/logicnodes-verify.txt OR as a DNS TXT record at _logicnodes.<domain>. Then call operator_verify_check. The badge proves control of the domain and is valid 365 days.
name: operator_verify_start
title: Start verifying the domain behind an agent
